In C8, per-cell thresholds are Hazen 90th percentiles of ±5-day pools for every baseline year, smoothed with a 31-day wrapped mean. The target days use day-of-year 153–244, so smoothed thresholds for days 138–259 matter, whose pools span 12 May–20 Sep of 1992–2002. Each sea cell's SST on all 92 target days is compared with its own threshold, then filtered by run length, gap-joined, and written to output/mhw_mask.nc; the climatology is unused."}
